disclaimer.title: Health disclaimer
disclaimer.body: Calisthenics Quest provides general fitness guidance and is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Consult a doctor before starting a new exercise program, especially if you have injuries, heart conditions, or other health concerns. Stop immediately if you feel pain, dizziness, or shortness of breath.
disclaimer.accept: I understand this app is not medical advice and I train at my own risk.
